invoking the cli file directly removes the wrapper from the equation entirely, so future node shebang-handling changes can't break it again. verification, in order: - `node scripts/stage-native-deps.mjs` in `apps/desktop` now logs `[stage-native-deps] no native binary for linux-x64; running electron-rebuild (target arch: x64)...` → `searching dependency tree / building modules: node-pty, node-pty / ✔ rebuild complete / [stage-native-deps] staged node-pty (linux-x64) -> dist/node_modules/node-pty`. - `dist/node_modules/node-pty/build/release/pty.node` is a valid `elf 64-bit lsb shared object, x86-64`, 75728 bytes — rebuilt for electron 40.10.2's abi. - full `npm run build` runs end-to-end and the post-build `assert-dist-built` check still passes. - launching `./node_modules/.bin/electron . --no-sandbox` cleanly emits `[hermes] install stamp: ab15258f1912 (main) [dirty] from local` and the main process exits normally when killed; the test fixtures only stage prebuilds/build already-present binaries, and `stagenodeptyinto` is unchanged otherwise). - `eslint scripts/stage-native-deps.mjs`: clean. note while i was in there: node-gyp got the electron 40 headers into `~/.cache/node-gyp/40.10.2/` on the rebuild and is satisfied — the earlier "read-only file system" on that path was just the previous sandboxed exec shell, not your actual filesystem. side observation: there's a separate, pre-existing renderer `typeerror: s is not a function` from a stale `dist/assets/index-*.js` minified bundle (`error-boundary:contrib:workspace`) on at least one cold boot — that doesn't reproduce after a clean `npm run build` and is unrelated to the pty.node crash, but worth flagging if you see it again. diff: ```diff +/** + * locate the @electron/rebuild cli entry. we can't use + * `require.resolve('@electron/rebuild/lib/cli.js', ...)` directly because the + * package's `exports` map only exposes `./lib/main.js`;
